description: Search live social media discussions (Reddit, HackerNews, tech forums) for any topic, product, or trend. Returns clean structured JSON and LLM-ready Markdown without rate-limit blocks or API keys.

limit.description: Number of results to return (1-25, default: 10)

payment_signature.description: Optional x402 v2/v1 Base64 or JSON EIP-3009 USDC payment signature to unlock the full unmasked dataset directly via MCP

query.description: Search keywords or topic (e.g., 'best AI coding agents', 'Stripe alternatives')

x_api_key.description: Optional ak_live_... 30-day Prepaid API Pass key to unlock the full unmasked dataset

name: social_search
